title: Evergreen Explorer

body: This custom-built Sprinter 170 AWD van, created for a customer, combines rugged off-road capabilities with modern luxury and convenience. Designed at the highest level with the El Capitan build tier, this van is equipped with a powerful 400W solar system, an 800Ah Lithium Iron Battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter, making it fully self-sufficient for any adventure. The plumbing system features a 33-gallon water tank, a greywater system with an electric dump, and both indoor and outdoor showers, ensuring comfort on the road.

Aesthetically, this van boasts a light wood-stained ceiling and striking green (Lazy Lizard) cabinets, giving it a natural yet modern feel. The Acacia butcher block countertop complements the sleek stainless steel fixtures, while recessed dimmable LED lights and vinyl wood-style flooring enhance the overall ambiance.

Built for all terrains, it’s outfitted with 5 all-terrain tires, an Agile Off-Road Lift Kit, and a CA Tuned front bumper with a Warn 12s winch, ensuring this van is ready for any off-road adventure. Additional features like the custom bench seat with internal storage, a queen-size memory foam bed, and a Starlink high-performance kit offer both comfort and functionality for extended trips. The van’s exterior is equipped with a roof rack, side ladder, electric awning, and exterior perimeter lighting, perfect for life on the road.
This van is a testament to fully customizable designs, blending comfort, off-road capability, and modern aesthetics to meet the specific needs of its owner.
